name: Cobblemon Quests [1.1.14 - Fabric]
changelog:
## Changes from 1.1.13
Added actions:
- Throw poké ball (at pokemon)

Added aspects:
- Level (min/max)
- Pokémon nature

Fixes:
- Winning in a fight against a player/npc no longer increases (almost) all other quests.

## Changes from 1.1.12
Added actions:
- Defeat player
- Defeat npc
- Evolve into
- Scan (Pokédex)
- Reel
- Have registered (Pokédex)

Other changes:
- Aspects (added in cobblemon 1.6) can now be selected as triggers for quests. Information on how can be read in the new [quest creation wiki](https://github.com/WinterWolfSV/Cobblemon_Quests/blob/1.1.13-(1.21.1)/quest-creation.md).
- `/givepokemon countascatch=true` no longer works, and is replaced by `/cobblemonquests givepokemon`. Read more about the command [here](https://github.com/WinterWolfSV/Cobblemon_Quests/blob/1.1.13-(1.21.1)/quest-creation.md#commands).

Fixes:
- The last entry in biomes/pokemon/form can now be selected. [#18](https://github.com/WinterWolfSV/Cobblemon_Quests/issues/18)
- Biome selection now shows correct biomes. [#19](https://github.com/WinterWolfSV/Cobblemon_Quests/issues/19)
- Trading no longer counts as a catch. [#20](https://github.com/WinterWolfSV/Cobblemon_Quests/issues/20)
